population.title: Cell Population Model
population.warnCollateral: {pct}% of healthy cells cross the lysis threshold, reduce field or tune frequency.
population.okWindow: {pct}% of target cells lysed · 0% healthy collateral. Therapeutic window is effective.
population.tipPopSize: Population Size N N=100, fast, coarse histogram · quick parameter scans N=300, balanced default · smooth histogram N=1000, high-fidelity · ideal for final analysis
population.tipRVariance: Radius Variance σ_R / R Gaussian spread of cell radius as % of mean R. Models natural cell-to-cell size heterogeneity. Mammalian ~10% · Bacteria ~20% · Virus ~30% Vm ∝ R → larger cells sit closer to lysis threshold.
population.tipResample: ⟳ Resample Generate a new random population. R and σ_i sampled independently per cell. σ_R = R × variance% σ(σ_i) = σ_i × uncertainty Uncertainty: mammalian 20% · bacteria 35% · virus 45%
population.tipExport: ↓ Export CSV Download all sampled DR values. Columns: cell_type · sample_index · DR
population.tipTargetCard: Target Population: {label} Outcome distribution at current field settings. Radius and σ_i sampled from Gaussian distributions. σ_i uncertainty: ±{uncPct}% DR = Vm × f_pulse / V_threshold
population.tipHealthyCard: Healthy Population: {label} Outcome distribution under the same shared field. Goal: 0% Lysed · low Rev-EP · high Stable fraction. σ_i uncertainty: ±{uncPct}%
population.tipLysedTarget: Target Lysed: {pct}% Fraction with DR ≥ 1.0, irreversible membrane disruption. Goal: maximise this fraction
population.tipRevEpTarget: Target Rev-EP: {pct}% DR 0.50-1.0, reversible electroporation zone. Membrane permeabilised; may recover with fewer pulses.
population.tipNourTarget: Target Nourishing: {pct}% DR 0.08-0.50, sub-EP Schwan coupling. Membrane partially stressed; cell is intact.
population.tipLysedHealthy: Healthy Lysed: {pct}% ⚠ Collateral damage, DR ≥ 1.0. Keep at 0%, reduce field or tune frequency.
population.tipRevEpHealthy: Healthy Rev-EP: {pct}% DR 0.50-1.0, reversible EP zone. Reversible at low duty cycle; monitor repeated pulses.
population.tipNourHealthy: Healthy Nourishing: {pct}% DR 0.08-0.50, sub-lytic Schwan coupling. Low-level membrane activity, generally safe.
population.tipChart: Population DR Histogram Monte Carlo disruption ratio distribution. Red = Target cells · Cyan = Healthy cells Threshold lines: 50%, Rev-EP onset 85%, Lysis countdown armed 100%, Lysis threshold Ideal: target near 100% · healthy near 0%.
population.tipNPill100: N=100 Fast · coarse histogram. Best for quick scans.
population.tipNPill1000: N=1000 High-fidelity · slow sampling. Ideal for final analysis.
population.tipMeanDr: Mean DR ± σ DR = Vm × f_pulse / V_threshold Mean: {mean} · σ: {std} σ_i uncertainty ±{uncPct}% modelled in each sample.
